QuestionStmt.S: Identify the product of reforming reaction of n-hexane in the presence of $\mathrm{V_2O_5}$ over alumina.

Solution.S:
Step 1: Reforming is a process in which straight-chain alkanes are converted into branched-chain alkanes or aromatic hydrocarbons in the presence of a catalyst (like $\mathrm{V_2O_5}$ or platinum on alumina) at high temperature and pressure.

Step 2: n-Hexane ($\mathrm{C_6H_{14}}$) undergoes dehydrocyclisation (reforming) to form benzene.

$$\mathrm{C_6H_{14} \xrightarrow{V_2O_5/Al_2O_3, \Delta} C_6H_6 + 4H_2}$$

The reaction involves loss of hydrogen and cyclisation to form a six-membered aromatic ring.

Step 3: Thus, the product of reforming of n-hexane is benzene.

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\text{Benzene}}$$

Hence, the correct option is A.
